733220701.text: *sigh* Is this... the corrosive power of the dark remnants?

733220702.text: Such terrible strength... I can't do anything against it no matter how hard I try...

733220703.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

733220704.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

733220705.text: The Sunyata Flowers are saved... Ah, I've been waiting for so long, and hope has finally arrived!

733220706.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

733220707.text: Don't get so worked up, Sefana! I will help you rescue the Sunyata Flowers, fret not!

733220708.text: #This is my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} companion, Paimon.

733220709.text: We have already extinguished the Sign of Apaosha, and have rescued flower ponds from dark corrosion. Leave the ponds under your charge to us.

733220710.text: Well, that sure was straightforward! Given what Sefana calls you, you two sure seem like you have a close relationship!

733220711.text: Close? I would not say so... though we did spend some time together and share some experiences...

733220712.text: Hmm, while I'm not sure why you're speaking a little differently, Sorush, I'll have you two know that she took great care of me in the past!

733220713.text: She said before the Sunyata Flower... "I shall be Simurgh's equal"... They encouraged me more than any teachings might.

733220714.text: From that day on, I have believed that her will was most commendable.

733220715.text: That's why I decided to follow the human custom of addressing one's elders when it comes to her, to show my respect!

733220716.text: That sure gets Paimon thinking. Ah, she can see it now...

733220717.text: St—Stop mentioning things from so long ago!

733220720.text: Right, Sister. Does your Yasnapati not understand much about the Sunyata Flowers? Perhaps I can introduce them, on behalf of the elders...

733220721.text: There was a Pari who once sang thus—

733220722.text: "This coalescence of color is the miraculous sign of the flowing spring of life"...

733220723.text: "Linger here with me, dance and sing with me, let us weave lasting joy"...

733220725.text: I've spent too long trying to clear the defilement that remains in this place. The exhaustion is clouding my mind...

733220726.text: Don't push yourself too much! It doesn't matter if you can't remember some quotations. Just say stuff in a more relaxed way!

733220727.text: Well then, let me think... Though the Sunyata Flowers are not the most precious thing within the Vourukasha Oasis, they are exceedingly dear companions to our people.

733220728.text: Many Pari spend time with those flowers after they've finished their work for the day.

733220729.text: It would be like a human growing up alongside those creatures that go "Meow-meow" and "Woof-woof"...

733220731.text: Huh, so that's how it is. Y'know, if Paimon had one of those as a pet for a while, and it got sick, Paimon would be really sad too.

733220732.text: Never mind what might happen if it was Paimon's only friend...

733220733.text: Paimon understands your urgency now, Sefana. The health of the Sunyata Flowers is definitely important!

733220734.text: Hmm... The importance of the Sunyata Flowers is far beyond such. You're still not all that good at analogies, Sefana.

733220735.text: Don't worry, we got the message. Since this is a serious issue, and Sorush is being so proactive, let's get going right away!

733220802.text: The Sunyata Flowers have been purged of their defilement. You need not worry any longer.

733220803.text: That's wonderful, Sister Sorush! You've always been so reliable.

733220804.text: #And you too, great Yasnapati {NICKNAME}! I have prepared a gift for you...

733220805.text: I picked up some shiny objects while caring for the Sunyata Flowers. I have heard that humans and their meow-meows and woof-woofs love them...

733220806.text: Would that be... Mora? Paimon wouldn't mind some if that were the case!

733220807.text: What gift could I get you, Sister Sorush?

733220808.text: How shallow, Sefana! What I did was out of a commitment to my great work. I require not your tokens of gratitude. You should instead focus on keeping yourself and the Sunyata Flowers in good shape.

733220809.text: Sorush means to say that you don't have to feel in debt and... should take good care of yourself? She does sound like a big sister now...

733220812.text: Nonsense! I was merely cautioning Sefana not to fail in her duty.

733220813.text: To use an analogy that humans can understand, both Sunyata Flowers and Pari hail from the dewdrops of the Harvisptokhm. And that makes us family.

733220814.text: The Pari who watch over the Sunyata Flowers are exposed to the constant encroachment of the defilement, so they must be wary of any bodily harm it may incur.

733220815.text: Despite Sefana's failings, she has guarded the Sunyata Flowers for a long time, and I shan't simply write her off.

733221001.text: The power of darkness hasn't been fully stopped... But all flower ponds have been purified and regained vitality...

733221002.text: What is happening? Is someone helping me?

733221003.text: If it's true, maybe the Harvisptokhm has graced me and these ponds with her blessings... How fortunate we are!

733221004.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

733221005.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

733221006.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

733221007.text: #Calm down. My comings and goings are not the point. What is important is that I and my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, have come to inform you that we've made up for your failings.

733221008.text: I pursue the great task of extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha, and along the way, I eliminated this dark corrosion and rescued all our flower ponds. But remember, Sefana, this was on account of your failings!

733221009.text: S—So it is all thanks to you, Sister Sorush!

733221011.text: I cannot thank you enough... I've always had butterflies in my stomach this whole time, and now I can finally breathe easy!

733221012.text: Huh, so Sefana calls Sorush "Sister"... But don't you think this big sister is too strict? Ugh, she's so unlovable...

733221013.text: Such immaturity! It is the duty of one senior to give pointers to their juniors. How can I speak softly to them in the face of such errors?

733221014.text: That... That's right! Sister Sorush has always taken good care of me...

733221015.text: The words Sister Sorush said before the Sunyata Flower... "I shall be Simurgh's equal"... They encouraged me more than any teachings might.

733221016.text: From that day on, I have believed that her will was most commendable.

733221017.text: That's why I decided to follow the human custom of addressing one's elders when it comes to her, to show my respect!

733221018.text: What a gentle Pari you are... Paimon can't imagine Sorush getting lectured by another Pari and still calling her "Sister" after that...

733221035.text: Paimon understands now, Sefana. The health of the Sunyata Flowers is definitely important! Our efforts were not in vain!

733221036.text: What a shallow, coarse analogy. The importance of the Sunyata Flowers is far beyond such. Your choice of words still requires some work, Sefana.

733221042.text: Sorush means to say that you don't have to feel in debt and... should take good care of yourself? She does sound like a big sister now...

733220501.text: Not bad, Sorush! You really made the area regain its vitality real quick, huh?

733220502.text: Pari powers are quite fascinating, yes.

733220503.text: You startle pointlessly! My powers are more than enough to easily rescue the Sunyata Flower!

733220504.text: The dark corrosion expands yet, and these Sunyata Flowers are but one amongst its many victims...

733220505.text: The other flower ponds have not been spared. Sefana must be in quite the fluster at this moment.

733220506.text: This Sefana you mentioned seems like a nice Pari who works hard to take care of the flowers...

733220508.text: Well now, I suppose it may serve as a suitable diversion upon my great work. In that case, my Yasnapati, I bid you have a care for Sunyata Flowers of this kind.

733220509.text: I'll tell you when I see them.

733220510.text: Yup! Let's save these pretty flowers together!

733220699.text: *sigh* Is this... the power of darkness?

733220902.text: All the Sunyata Flowers have been revitalized. Fear no more, Sefana.

733220903.text: That's wonderful, Sister Sorush! You've always been so reliable all these years.

733220904.text: #And you too, great Yasnapati {NICKNAME}! I have prepared a gift for you...

733220905.text: I picked up some shiny objects while caring for the Sunyata Flowers. I have heard that humans and their meow-meows and woof-woofs love them...

733220906.text: Would that be... Mora? Paimon wouldn't mind some if that were the case!

733220907.text: What gift could I get you, Sister Sorush?

733220908.text: There's no need, Sefana. Just take care of yourself and the Sunyata Flowers.

733220909.text: That's surprisingly nice, and Sorush sounds like a big sister, too... You two do have a close relationship!

733220912.text: I'm not trying to hide anything! I just genuinely want Sefana to take better care of herself!

733220913.text: After all, to use an analogy that humans can understand, both Sunyata Flowers and Pari hail from the dewdrops of the Harvisptokhm. And that makes us family.

733220914.text: The Pari who take care of the Sunyata Flowers are under the constant encroachment of the defilement, which is a great burden to bear.

733220915.text: Sefana is a tough soul, always shouldering the responsibility on her own. And she's also been respectful to me too. It's only natural that I want to take care of her.

733221101.text: Before I knew it, the power of darkness had been eliminated... and the ponds had been revitalized...

733221102.text: What happened? Was it because of the rain?

733221103.text: If that's the case, it means the Harvisptokhm has graced me and these ponds with her blessings... How fortunate we are!

733221104.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

733221105.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

733221106.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

733221107.text: You need to calm down, Sefana!
